title: Windows CC build fails with compiler/linker out-of-memory errors under high parallelism
signature: Windows Release build runs out of memory - compiler fatal error C1060 (out of heap space) and linker fatal error LNK1102 (out of memory) under high parallelism|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode
failed_jobs.symptom: ninja build stopped after 8 link targets failed with 'LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory'

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_windows_cc
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check failed because Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode failed

key_errors: FAILED: C:/actions-runner/_work/openvino/openvino/openvino/bin/intel64/Release/openvino_mock1_frontend.dll ... LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory
FAILED: .../ov_subgraphs_dumper.exe ... LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory

FAILED: .../benchmark_app.exe, classification_sample_async.exe, sync_benchmark.exe, throughput_benchmark.exe, ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe, ov_transformations_tests.exe ... LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory
root_cause: The Windows Conditional Compilation (CC COLLECT) build ran out of memory during the final link phase: 8 separate link targets (DLLs and EXEs including openvino_mock1_frontend, ov_subgraphs_dumper, benchmark_app, ov_gpu_unit_tests, ov_transformations_tests, and samples) all failed with 'LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory' within the same ~1-minute window (09:34:04-09:34:21), indicating the Windows runner's available memory/virtual-address space was exhausted by concurrent MSVC link.exe processes running at high parallelism (ninja default parallelism against limited runner RAM), not a code defect. This is the 5th occurrence of this exact signature since 2026-11-03, always on Windows CC/Release link steps under similar conditions, confirming a persistent runner-capacity/parallelism limitation rather than a one-off fluke.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires reproducing memory pressure on an identical Windows CI runner (limited RAM) while linking the full OpenVINO Release CC build with ninja's default high parallelism (-j matching CPU core count). Not reliably reproducible locally unless the workstation has comparably constrained memory.
recommended_actions: Reduce ninja/MSBuild link parallelism for the Windows CC Release build job (e.g., set CMAKE_JOB_POOL_LINK or pass -j N to ninja with a lower N for the link phase) to limit concurrent link.exe processes.
Increase the Windows CC runner's available memory (upgrade runner SKU) or enable a larger page file/swap.

Split build targets across multiple jobs/matrix legs to reduce concurrent linking pressure, or build fewer optional targets (samples, dumper tools, benchmark apps) in the CC Collect job if they are not required for conditional-compilation statistics collection.

Investigate whether /INCREMENTAL:NO plus many LARGEADDRESSAWARE 64-bit link invocations in parallel is pushing committed memory past the runner limit, and consider serializing the largest link targets.
prevention_strategies: Cap ninja link-step parallelism (job pools) independently of compile-step parallelism on memory-constrained Windows runners; monitor runner memory utilization during Release link phases and add alerting before LNK1102 becomes a recurring post-commit blocker; consider a lighter 'CC Collect' build profile that skips unnecessary sample/tool executables.
historical_context: This exact signature (pattern 80cfa127185fbf3e) has now been recorded 5 times since 2026-11-03 (runs 41586716106, 43241364429, 43336008835, 43365664671, 43369333911, and now 43398622571), all on the Windows Conditional Compilation build job, consistently manifesting as compiler C1060 or linker LNK1102 out-of-memory errors during high-parallelism Release builds/links. No infra-level fix has resolved it yet; it remains an open, recurring Windows CC capacity issue.
